verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a Jules bulk-operation feature, such as dispatching one action across many repos, issues or PRs at once. The API is a developer building block a user could script batches with, and the usage-limit tiers only describe task quotas. The community remark about handling large quantities of tasks describes running many individual tasks, not a bulk-action capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
